rules.name: Dining credit
rules.eligibility_notes: Up to $10 in statement credits each month when paying with the Gold Card at Grubhub (including Seamless), Buffalo Wild Wings, Five Guys, The Cheesecake Factory and Wonder.

rules.name: Resy credit
rules.eligibility_notes: Up to $50 from January through June and up to $50 from July through December for eligible purchases at qualifying U.S. Resy restaurants. Enrollment through the card account.

rules.name: Dunkin' credit
rules.eligibility_notes: Up to $7 in statement credits each month at U.S. Dunkin' locations when paying with the Gold Card.

rules.name: Uber Cash
rules.eligibility_notes: $10 in Uber Cash each month after adding the Gold Card to the Uber account; usable on U.S. rides and orders with an Amex card selected. Uber Cash is spent in Uber, so a card statement cannot show its use.

rules.name: The Hotel Collection $100 credit
rules.eligibility_notes: Book two consecutive nights or more at a Hotel Collection property (over 1,300 hotels per product page) through AmexTravel.com or the Amex Travel App, paid with the eligible Card. Eligible on-property charges vary by property. Also includes room upgrade and 12pm check-in / 4pm late check-out when available. Back-to-back stays within 24 hours at the same property count as one stay. Per booking: 'Benefits are applied per room, per stay (with a three-room limit per stay).' Applied at check-out by the property, not as an Amex statement credit. Must be used during the stay; not redeemable for cash. No enrollment stated.

rules.name: American Express Venue Collection: 10% back on concessions
rules.eligibility_notes: Qualifying concessions purchases at American Express Venue Collection venues with the enrolled Card. The product page does not list specific venues. 10% back on qualifying concessions purchases, up to $250 back per calendar year. amount_cents is the annual cap. Product page: enroll your Card; 'Limit one enrolled Card per Card Member.'
